name: opencode
title: OpenCode
description: Control OpenCode from the launcher: browse and resume sessions, create new work, ask questions, and review changes. OpenCode stays the coding environment.
author: AdityaZxxx

commands.name: sessions
commands.title: Sessions
commands.subtitle: OpenCode
commands.description: Browse, search, resume, and manage OpenCode sessions.

commands.name: projects
commands.title: Projects
commands.subtitle: OpenCode
commands.description: Browse projects known to OpenCode and jump into new or recent work.

commands.name: ask
commands.title: Ask
commands.subtitle: OpenCode
commands.description: Ask OpenCode anything, optionally scoped to a project. Streams answers with follow-ups and model selection.

commands.name: review-changes
commands.title: Review
commands.subtitle: OpenCode
commands.description: Read working tree, staged, or branch diffs per file, then ask OpenCode to review or explain them.

commands.name: new-session
commands.title: New Session
commands.subtitle: OpenCode
commands.description: Start a new OpenCode session: pick a project, enter a prompt, and open it in the terminal.

preferences.name: serverUrl
preferences.title: Server URL
preferences.description: Explicit OpenCode server endpoint, for example http://127.0.0.1:49374. Leave empty to auto-discover the local OpenCode service.

preferences.name: serverUsername
preferences.title: Server Username
preferences.description: HTTP basic auth username for the configured server. Only used when a Server URL is set. Defaults to opencode.

preferences.name: serverPassword
preferences.title: Server Password
preferences.description: HTTP basic auth password for the configured server. Sent only over HTTPS or to local addresses. Local services discovered automatically handle auth themselves.

preferences.name: openCodePath
preferences.title: OpenCode Executable
preferences.description: Path or name of the OpenCode V2 executable used to open sessions, for example /usr/local/bin/opencode. Leave empty to auto-detect opencode2 or opencode on PATH.

preferences.name: notifyOnCompletion
preferences.title: Completion Notifications
preferences.label: Notify when a watched session finishes
preferences.description: Send a desktop notification when a session you explicitly waited on finishes. Only applies while a Vicinae window is open.
